definitions.gloss: after birth; since birth (giving a baby's or animal's age)
definitions.explanation: The time since a baby or young animal was born; used with a number to give its age in days, weeks or months.

examples.japanese: {生後|せいご}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧。

examples.english: The puppy came to our house when it was two months old.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{生後|せいご}まもなく⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This illness is often discovered shortly after birth.

notes:
{生|せい} (birth) + ⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {生後|せいご} + number + か{月|げつ} / ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧: ~ months / days old
- {生後|せいご}まもなく: shortly after birth
- {生後|せいご}{一年未満|いちねんみまん}: under one year old

WATCH OUT:
⟦{生前|せいぜん}→生前：16391_seizen⟧ does not mean "before birth": it means "while (someone now dead) was alive". The opposite of {生後|せいご} is {出生前|しゅっしょうまえ} or ⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧.
